plugins.description: Design data and recommendation layer for AI coding assistants. Includes a searchable database of styles, palettes, typography, charts, and UX guidelines for React, Next.js, Astro, Vue, Nuxt.js, Nuxt UI, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, and Three.js, plus generator skills for banners, brand identity, logos, and slides.
